issues.title: Zonemap-prunable join key-set filter through compressed-materialization projections
issues.hypothesis: After the 15M-group subquery agg, q18 rescans lineitem (60M rows: scan 0.16s + probe HASH_JOIN 0.26s CPU) and orders (15M rows: scan 0.20s + SEMI join 0.11s CPU) only to keep ~111 order keys. Both tables are stored clustered on the join key, so a key-set filter could skip most row groups through zonemaps. Two things currently block this. (1) JoinFilterPushdownOptimizer::GetPushdownFilterTargets / PushdownJoinFilterExpression (src/optimizer/join_filter_pushdown_optimizer.cpp:23-56,144-160) stops at the `__internal_compress_integral_uinteger(#0, 1)` projection above each scan, because it accepts only BOUND_COLUMN_REF and integral BOUND_CAST. (2) JoinFilterPushdownInfo::CanUseInFilter (physical_hash_join.cpp:714) emits the zonemap-only IN filter only when ht->Count() <= dynamic_or_filter_threshold (default 50), and q18 builds about 111 keys. Measured with dbe-tool sql, full q18 LIMIT 1, alternating runs in one session with compressed_materialization disabled: threshold 50 gave 725 and 672 ms, threshold 1000 gave 604 and 574 ms (about -15%). EXPLAIN ANALYZE confirms 'optional: l_orderkey IN (...)' reaches the lineitem scan, and the lineitem probe join drops from 0.26s to 0.01s. With compression on, raising the threshold does nothing (590 vs 595), which confirms blocker (1). Disabling compression costs elsewhere, so the real fix must keep compression and push through it.
issues.plan: Step A, push through compress: add `Value storage_offset` (null by default) to JoinFilterPushdownColumn (src/include/duckdb/execution/operator/join/join_filter_pushdown.hpp:25). In PushdownJoinFilterExpression, accept ExpressionClass::BOUND_FUNCTION when function.name starts with "__internal_compress_integral_", children[1] is a BoundConstantExpression, children[0] is integral and <= 64-bit, and no offset is set yet. Store the constant as storage_offset and recurse into children[0]. In JoinFilterPushdownInfo::FinalizeFilters and PushInFilter (physical_hash_join.cpp:720-911), when storage_offset is set, map each build-side compressed value v to the storage domain: cast v and the offset to HUGEINT, add them, then DefaultTryCastAs(storage_type), and skip the filter if that fails. Always skip the bloom filter when an offset is set (the has_cast check already does this; make it explicit). Validate step A with `SET dynamic_or_filter_threshold=1000` in dbe-tool sql: q18 should beat 595 ms. Step B, respect the threshold but still prune: when ht->Count() > threshold but <= a cap (e.g. 64*threshold, so ScanKeyColumn stays cheap), sort the unique non-null keys, keep the (threshold-1) largest gaps as boundaries, and push OptionalFilter(ConjunctionOrFilter of ConjunctionAndFilter(>=lo, <=hi)) with at most `threshold` ranges. ConjunctionOrFilter::CheckStatistics already prunes through zonemaps (conjunction_filter.cpp:10). Keep IsDenseRange/ContainsNull bail-outs. Do not change the setting default (rules.md forbids it).
issues.expected_gain: q18 -5..-12%: about 0.45s CPU on lineitem scan+probe and about 0.3s on orders scan+semi, of which most row groups become prunable.
issues.generality: Any selective hash join whose probe side is a scan clustered or sorted on the key (date and id joins, IN-subqueries over fact tables, star joins with filtered dimensions), now also through the compress projections that compressed materialization inserts on most large joins. Possible slowdowns: building and sorting up to a few thousand keys per join finalize, plus per-row-group checks of up to 50 ranges. Both are tiny, and the filter is optional (zonemap only), so it does no row-level work.
issues.risk: Medium-low. Correctness depends on the offset mapping (overflow is handled through HUGEINT and the try-cast bail-out), and the filter is optional, so a wrong prune is the only failure mode. Range bounds must be inclusive and computed in the storage type. NULL keys: keep the existing ContainsNull bail-out.

dispatch: Zonemap-prunable join key-set filter through compressed-materialization projections
output.memory:
## Memory (planner, q18 specialisation run)

### Workload facts (q18 only visible template; baseline ~595-670 ms hot, 8 threads)
- Plan: IN-subquery `GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING sum(l_quantity) > X` over all of lineitem (60M rows -> 15M groups -> ~111 after HAVING).
  HASH_GROUP_BY = 4.6-5.0s CPU (~455 ms wall isolated). Outer part (~160 ms wall): lineitem rescan 0.16s + probe join 0.26s CPU (60M rows vs 111-row build),
  orders scan 0.20s + SEMI join 0.11s, customer scan 0.10s + join 0.29s CPU (builds a 1.5M-row HT for 111 probe rows).
- Group key arrives compressed as UINTEGER (compressed materialization), fixed-width. sum_no_overflow(decimal) -> SumState<int64_t>.
- lineitem/orders stored clustered on orderkey (~4 equal keys per run) -> zonemaps can prune by key set.

### Key measurements (dbe-tool sql; several ;-separated statements per call work; the first run is cold; ±15% noise -> ALTERNATE variants in one call)
- Agg per-group cost ~125 ns CPU at 8t, linear in groups; per-row ~14 ns. Sink dominates (LIMIT 1 ~410 vs 440).
- R4 ablation (E0004): no sink sub-step >8%; finalize re-materialisation 15% (in-place already failed); bigger local capacity +30%; radix bits 9-10 +30%.
  => THE AGGREGATE IS EXHAUSTED for this design. Don't propose more radix-agg sink/finalize tweaks.
- R5: with compressed_materialization disabled, alternating runs show dynamic_or_filter_threshold 50: 725/672 ms vs 1000: 604/574 ms;
  the IN filter reaches the lineitem scan and the probe join drops 0.26s->0.01s. With compression ON, the threshold has no effect (blocked).

### Codebase facts
- Radix sink: Sink() (radix_partitioned_hashtable.cpp:548) -> ht.AddChunk (aggregate_hashtable.cpp:519) -> FindOrCreateGroupsInternal (:641).
- Join filter pushdown: optimizer src/optimizer/join_filter_pushdown_optimizer.cpp (PushdownJoinFilterExpression accepts only colref + integral cast;
  projection case :144). Runtime: physical_hash_join.cpp CanUseInFilter :714 (Count <= dynamic_or_filter_threshold, default 50), PushInFilter :720
  (OptionalFilter = zonemap only), FinalizeFilters :814 (min/max + bloom; bloom skipped if has_cast). JoinFilterPushdownColumn in
  include/.../join_filter_pushdown.hpp:25 {probe_column_index, storage_type}.
- compress_integral: out = in - min (min = constant arg 2); decompress: min + in. ConjunctionOrFilter::CheckStatistics prunes zonemaps.
- Compressed materialization runs inside statistics propagation, before JOIN_FILTER_PUSHDOWN.
- rules.md: default settings are off-limits -> can't just raise dynamic_or_filter_threshold; must use engine logic (range merging).
- Settings: perfect_ht_threshold=12, memory_limit 12.2GiB, disabled_optimizers works. dbe-tool has no perf; use ablation via SET VARIABLE.

### Directions
- Retired: E0001 run-collapse, E0002 in-place finalize, E0003 skip staging, E0004 agg ablation (nothing >8%).
- R5 dispatched: key-set zonemap filter pushed through compress projections (step A: offset mapping; step B: <=threshold merged ranges
  when the key count exceeds the threshold). If it fails, check whether the failure was in implementation (did the filter reach the scan? check
  EXPLAIN ANALYZE 'Dynamic Filters') or in the idea (pruning not happening at row-group level).
- Next candidates: (a) customer join builds 1.5M-row HT for 111 probe rows: a build/probe side swap at runtime or join-order fix (~50 ms wall,
  higher risk); (b) dense-key direct-index aggregate (2-round effort, see the q13 auto-memory analog).
- Backlog 'radix sink partition growth' is superseded by E0004 (repartitions cheap) -> effectively dead.
